name: System Network Proxy Settings Modified
description: Detects modification of the Internet Settings proxy configuration. Adversaries may change proxy settings to intercept network traffic or redirect it to a malicious server.

action.description: The system's network proxy configuration was modified. SIEM should inspect the new proxy address.

operational_usage: This is a critical feature for detecting traffic interception. A change to 'ProxyEnable' (often to 1), 'ProxyServer', or 'AutoConfigURL' by any process other than a browser, VPN client, or Group Policy is highly suspicious.
false_positive: Legitimate changes by users, VPN software, or corporate network configuration scripts can occur. The context of the modifying process is key.
